procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 57476 was represented by Leonard Kersten.
facts: GER 57476 was not informed via the online system that she was a party to the hearing of case no. 27.
When GER 57467 became aware of the result of the hearing she lodged the request to reopen.
GER 57467 intends to present the tracking data showing that she has taken a two turns penalty.
conclusions: GER 57476 was unavoidably absent at the original hearing.
The International Jury may have made a significant error in the original hearing. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(2) for reopening the hearing are met.
